senses.gloss: m. (תרג = שרג q. v.) [the shining,] Ethrog, a kind of orange or citron used with the festive wreath on the Feast of Booths (= פרי עץ הדר Lev. XXIII, 40; v. Targ.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:9">Succ. IV, 9</cite> <he>באֶתְרוֹגֵיהֶן</he> with their ethrogim (which they had brought into the Temple); a. e.
